name: Auntea Jenny (Shanghai) Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Auntea Jenny (Shanghai) Industrial Co., Ltd., a Shanghai beverage company incorporated in 2013, operates freshly made tea shops, franchised and self-run, under names including Auntea Jenny and Fallstea. It also manages supply chains, sells online, produces raw materials, manages catering and sells software and IT services. Previously Shanghai Zhenjing Industrial Co., Ltd., it took its present name in November 2023.
